# Documentation cleanup

Follow the project's documentation guide. Preserve requirement IDs, acceptance identities, historical decision IDs and evidence records. Update existing notes instead of creating duplicate owners; label planned commands and missing capabilities as planned.

Check the tracker, changelog and docs together. Do not mark an unfinished requirement complete because its plan is stale. Run the docs/link check and review properties and claims. Change baseline hashes only when an authorised baseline change occurred.
